ops.old:

route: emergency                  # normal or major (emergency: backfill after the repair); never below the route `aidd gate --paths` computes
confidence: high                  # high, medium, low (low: stop)
open_questions: []                # facts still unknown; empty when confidence is high
trace_id: inc-481
assisted_by: []                   # "harness/model" for every agent that writes code or tests; fill before Spec approval
rollback: Revert the PR/MR.       # name the steps on major and emergency
residual_risk: none
